plugins.name: claudetto
plugins.description: Tunes Claude Code for coding at the lowest token cost, through its official extension points only: settings, hooks, skills, and an output style. It patches nothing.

plugins.name: claudetto-you-should-know
plugins.description: Shows a short note above the prompt when a side check finds something about the work you likely missed. Off by default; once on, one small request every sixth step, no telemetry.

plugins.name: claudetto-openspec
plugins.description: A lean OpenSpec workflow: one deferred tool that validates, reports status, and archives a change, and six short skills. It needs no openspec executable and no network.
